parts.name: LED ring 24
parts.notes: WS2812B 24 LED ring, 66 mm OD, 5 V. Search: "WS2812B ring 24 LED 5V"

parts.name: Encoder EC11
parts.notes: EC11 rotary encoder with push switch, 6 mm knurled shaft, 15 mm long, M7 nut. Search: "EC11 rotary encoder push switch 15mm"

parts.name: M5 T-nut for 2020
parts.notes: Drop-in M5 T-nuts for 2020 slot 6. Search: "2020 M5 drop in T nut"

parts.name: Slot cover strip
parts.notes: 2020 slot cover strip, cut 236 mm; hides the lamp wires in the stem's back slot. Search: "2020 slot cover strip 6mm"

parts.name: Rubber foot
parts.notes: Self-adhesive rubber bumpers 12.7 x 3.5 mm. Search: "rubber bumper feet 12.7mm"

parts.name: PTC fuse 2A
parts.notes: Resettable polyfuse, 2 A hold, radial. Search: "PTC resettable fuse 2A radial"

parts.name: 330 ohm resistor
parts.notes: In the LED data line. Search: "resistor assortment kit"

parts.name: 1000uF capacitor
parts.notes: 1000 uF 10 V electrolytic, soldered across the ring's 5V/GND. Search: "1000uF 10V electrolytic capacitor"

parts.name: Silicone hook-up wire 26 AWG
parts.notes: About 1.2 m of 3 colours (red, black, green) plus heat-shrink. Search: "26 AWG silicone wire kit"

parts.name: Double-sided foam tape
parts.notes: Holds the ESP32 board, USB-C breakout and LED ring. Search: "3M double sided foam tape"

parts.name: USB-C charger 20 W + cable
parts.notes: Any 5 V / 3 A USB-C charger and C-to-C cable works; skip if you have one. Search: "20W USB C charger with cable"

parts.name: M3×10 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M3 x 10mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

parts.name: M4×30 socket head screw
parts.notes: search: M4x30 socket head cap screw

parts.name: M2.5×8 self-tapping screw for plastic
parts.notes: search: M2.5 x 8mm pan head self tapping screws for plastic

soldering_reason: The LED ring, encoder, fuse and USB-C breakout are wired to the ESP32 with short soldered leads to fit inside the slim base and head.
